1.0.field_description: Numeric value used to represent the age of the patient when exposure to a specific environmental factor began.

1.2.field_description: Numeric value used to describe the average number of days each week that a person consumes an alcoholic beverage.

1.3.field_title: Amount of Alcohol Consumption per day?
1.3.field_description: Numeric value used to describe the average number of alcoholic beverages a person consumes per day.

1.4.field_description: A response to a question that asks whether the participant has consumed at least 12 drinks of any kind of alcoholic beverage in their lifetime.

1.5.field_description: Category to describe the patient's current level of alcohol use as self-reported by the patient.

1.7.field_description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether the patient was exposed to asbestos.

1.8.field_title: Average number of cigarettes smoked per day
1.8.field_description: The average number of cigarettes smoked per day.

1.9.field_description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether a patient was exposed to fine powder derived by the crushing of coal.

1.10.field_description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether a patient was exposed to smoke that is emitted from burning tobacco, including cigarettes, pipes, and cigars. This includes tobacco smoke exhaled by smokers.

1.11.field_description: Text term used to describe the length of time the patient was exposed to an environmental factor.

1.12.field_description: The text term used to describe the type of environmental exposure.

1.13.field_description: Numeric value that represents the number of times the patient uses marijuana each day.

1.14.field_description: Numeric computed value to represent lifetime tobacco exposure defined as number of cigarettes smoked per day x number of years smoked divided by 20.

1.15.field_description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether the patient was exposed to radon.

1.16.field_description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether a patient was exposured to respirable crystalline silica, a widespread, naturally occurring, crystalline metal oxide that consists of different forms including quartz, cristobalite, tridymite, tripoli, ganister, chert and novaculite.

1.17.field_title: Was the Participant exposed to secondhand smoke as a child?
1.17.field_description: The text term used to indicate whether the patient was exposed to secondhand smoke as a child.

1.19.field_description: The text term used to generally decribe how often the patient smokes.

1.20.field_title: How soon after the patient wakes/woke up does/did the patient smoke?
1.20.field_description: The text term used to describe the approximate amount of time elapsed between the time the patient wakes up in the morning to the time they smoke their first cigarette.

1.21.field_title: Year of onset of tobacco smoking
1.21.field_description: The year in which the participant began smoking.

1.22.field_description: The year in which the participant quit smoking.
